mcp_tools.name: engineering_work_package_structuring
mcp_tools.title: Engineering work package structuring
mcp_tools.description: Submits a work-package structure record (package definition, deliverables and documents, document control and revisions, check discipline and transmittals, delivery quality and handover) and returns a deterministic WORK_PACKAGE_STRUCTURED / WORK_PACKAGE_NOT_STRUCTURED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed sign-off, independent-check and transmittal-coverage checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record; it structures no package.

inputSchema.description: The work-package manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

documents.description: Declared documents: {name, kind, status, revision, revision_reason_declared, revision_history_present, designer, checker, prepared_by, reviewed_by, approved_by, purpose_declared, inputs_declared, assumptions_declared, standards_cited_declared, units_declared, results_declared, check_signature_declared}.

transmittals.description: Declared transmittals: {document, recipient, revision, date, return_status_declared}.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid per SERVICE.md: definition complete, deliverable kind 'calc package' in vocabulary, document status 'For Approval' in flow, revision 'A', designer Alice != checker Bob, sign-off complete, transmittal names Calc-001 with matching revision A and valid date 2026-11-20. [Tester correction R2: designer carried computed quantities only in prose notes; added structured computed_spot_checks.]
